assertions.scope: Independent RP52 execution of actual default and explicit V2 CLI file/compile/check and mobile routes against old source, anchored Legacy markers and directives, plus healthy recovery and explicit Legacy/compatibility controls. Repository inspection binds all six C compile export signatures and exact mode/profile forwarding, and the Swift public default and complete private compile bridge body; lexical inspection is not iOS ABI execution. The same fresh selection verifies immutable upstream declaration bytes and reviewed corrections, rejects Git replacement-object evidence, and executes the actual isolated Legacy metadata/reference/include program through migration and canonical V2 compilation with native equivalence, rejection preservation and recovery. Explicitly selected Legacy remains authorized under original U04. Only RP52 receives integration/repository records; U01/U04/CL03/RP33/BRG19 and Apple runtime are not inherited.
